query: INSERT INTO enquiries (id, kind, call_id, chat_id, phone_number_id, owner_user_id, agent_id, caller_e164, caller_name, contact, for_whom, subject, body, urgency, details) SELECT $1, $2, c.id, $3, c.phone_number_id, c.owner_user_id, c.agent_id, c.from_e164, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10 FROM calls c WHERE c.id = $11
